page.overview:
Who is Ireton MaSade?

Ireton MaSade was a lord marshal of the Imperial Army and a warrior of much fame during the Great Crusade and an exemplar to the troops of the Excertus Imperialis. Enlisting as a simple trooper in the Imperial Army, Ireton MaSade's ascension would be steep indeed, ending not only in command of an entire expeditionary fleet, but as ruler of a newly Compliant Imperial world.

While exemplary, his career would hardly have led him to be remembered as he is now -- the esteemed former Imperial Commander of the Agathean Domain -- having retired several solar decades prior to the events of the Horus Heresy.

Had it not been for the death of his beloved granddaughter, Jocasta MaSade, the "Old General" might well have been forgotten and the Imperium deprived of one of its greatest heroes. As it was, this minor event would make Ireton MaSade come out of seclusion and take command of the Agathean Cohorts, who would go on to valiantly fight against the traitorous forces of the Warmaster Horus during the galactic civil war.

By birth, Ireton MaSade was a Terran, having been born to the scavenger tribes of the Talacra Silt Wastes to the west of Old Albia in the late eighth century of the 30th Millennium. As a young man, he, like millions of others, joined the muster of what would soon become the Excertus Imperialis or Imperial Army. Ireton MaSade enlisted as a common soldier, but his aptitudes would see him assigned to the Solar Auxilia, the highly-equipped elite cohorts of the Emperor of Mankind's baseline Human troops.
